1: Chapter 1: Visitor on a Rainy Night
The rain in Qingshi had been falling for three full days. Lin Xiaoyu's sister had gone to the capital in spring, and since then, she alone tended this small apothecary in town.
After nightfall, she secured the doors and windows, counted the day's earnings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
She had just lain down when urgent knocking came from downstairs, followed by a man's voice: "Anyone home?"
A soaked young man stood at the door, his left arm wrapped in bloodstained cloth strips. He said his name was Bai Yun, and that he was from the Azure Dragon Society.
"I need my wound dressed," Bai Yun said quietly. "I can pay — will three thousand five hundred wen be enough?"
From his robe he produced a letter wrapped in oiled paper. "This letter must reach Qingfeng before the eighteenth of the fifth month."
While she bandaged him, he gave a wry smile. "If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a young woman's door in the middle of the night, she'd be jealous."
Lin Xiaoyu didn't take his money, only said: "Tomorrow at dawn, I'll take you up the mountain."
2: They set off at first light. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back, filled with dried rations, herbs, and an old umbrella.

Halfway up the mountain they ran into Zhou Dashan, an old woodcutter. He set down his axe and lowered his voice: yesterday evening three outsiders had been asking around the town gate about a wounded young man.
"Xiaoyu, take the narrow trail," Zhou Dashan said. "The main road isn't safe." Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The trail was narrow and slick. Lin Xiaoyu led the way, each step sure and steady. Bai Yun followed behind without a word.

By noon the rain had stopped and the mountain mist slowly lifted, revealing the roof of Qingfeng Temple in the distance. A nun stood at the temple gate — Zhao Qiuyue, the guest master in charge of receiving visitors.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, examined the red seal on the flap, and nodded. "The abbot has waited two years for this letter."
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, "I owe you my life." Lin Xiaoyu smiled. "Then next time you come, help me fix the roof of the apothecary." Bai Yun stayed at the temple.
Toward evening Lin Xiaoyu descended the mountain alone. By the time she reached home it was fully dark. She lit a lamp and sat behind the counter for a long while.
